serviceIdentification.serviceDescription: VulcanGov (Justinian for Government) is a SaaS AI platform for government: an AI agent workspace grounded in a curated, continuously updated library of federal and state statutes, regulations, guidance and housing datasets, with full-text and semantic search, secure single-use agent sandboxes for code execution and document generation, and an administration console for agency user management, session audit visibility and usage export. It is delivered from a government-only environment in AWS GovCloud (US) (us-gov-east-1) on a containerized microservices architecture: AWS ECS Fargate, Aurora PostgreSQL, S3 object storage, OpenSearch and ElastiCache. Federal customer data is stored in AWS GovCloud (US). Since 2026-11-11, large language model inference runs in Amazon Bedrock in AWS GovCloud (US) (us-gov-east-1 and us-gov-west-1), reached through a private endpoint: prompts and the content supplied with them are processed there. Every cross-boundary resource, including any temporary deviation, is disclosed in the published third-party information resources and service-scope lists rather than omitted. Data is encrypted at rest (AWS KMS, AES-256) and in transit (TLS 1.2/1.3) with FIPS 140-validated cryptographic modules; identity and access are federated through Okta for Government with enforced multi-factor authentication; security monitoring uses Datadog for Government, Wiz for Government and native AWS security services. Available to federal, state and local governments and to organizations working on their behalf. Public offering information, the secure configuration guide and live availability status are published on the Trust Center at https://trust.vulcangov.app; FedRAMP Certification Data is available to federal reviewers through its gated portal.

trustCenter.repositoryDescription: VulcanGov FedRAMP Trust Center: public offering information (human-readable and JSON), in-scope service list, certification progress, and live availability status (status.vulcangov.app). Federal agency access to full FedRAMP Certification Data is provided through the gated portal.
trustCenter.accessRequestInstructions: The public tier requires no authentication. Federal agency users obtain FedRAMP Certification Data through the gated portal at https://trust.vulcangov.app/portal: enter a .gov or .mil email address, receive a one-time code by email, and download artifacts for 12 hours; no approval step and no provider action is required. Programmatic access (artifact index and downloads with the session token) is documented at https://trust.vulcangov.app/portal/api-docs. Parties without a .gov/.mil address (for example contractors acting on behalf of an agency) may request access by emailing security@vulcan.ai from their organizational address.

secureConfigurationGuidance.repositoryDescription: VulcanGov Secure Configuration Guide, public — human-readable at https://trust.vulcangov.app/scg.html, machine-readable JSON at https://trust.vulcangov.app/scg.json, generated from the same source (CDS-CSO-CBF). No authentication or access request required.

assessor.name: A-LIGN Compliance and Security, Inc. dba A-LIGN

certifiedServices.serviceDescription: Conversational AI and long-running agent sessions, including file uploads for AI-assisted analysis and Office-compatible document collaboration. File uploads are in the assessed scope; deployment restrictions and required administrative grants are described in the Secure Configuration Guide.
Curated legal, regulatory, legislative, and housing datasets with full-text and semantic search, kept current by automated synchronization.
Isolated, single-use execution environments that support agent sessions (code execution, document generation).
Organization and user management, session audit visibility, and usage export for agency administrators.

certified.useCase: AWS GovCloud (US), FedRAMP High. Infrastructure hosting and, since 2026-11-11, model inference (Amazon Bedrock, Anthropic Claude models in us-gov-east-1 and us-gov-west-1; model invocation logging is not enabled). VulcanGov infrastructure and federal customer data reside in AWS GovCloud (US), apart from the disclosed cross-boundary resources listed here.

AWS US East/West, FedRAMP Moderate. Not used for inference since 2026-11-11: inference runs in AWS GovCloud (US), and managed web search is off. Bridge retirement: the GovCloud VPN path was removed on 2026-11-12. The commercial gateways, log collector, fetcher and associated connectivity were removed by 2026-11-13. The account remains in scope for retained logs, administrative records and dormant network configuration; it no longer provides inference or web-fetch workloads.
Datadog for Government, FedRAMP High. Monitoring, logging and application telemetry.
Okta for Government High (Okta IDaaS Government High Cloud), FedRAMP High. Identity and single sign-on for VulcanGov users.
Wiz for U.S. Government, FedRAMP High. Cloud security posture management and agentless vulnerability scanning of the VulcanGov AWS GovCloud (US) environment.

independentAssessmentSummary.summary: A-LIGN (FedRAMP Recognized independent assessor; lead assessor Dennis Coats) completed the initial FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) assessment on September 11, 2026. It assessed 203 practices: 46 KSIs and 157 rules. Its recorded results were 202 implemented and one gap: FRC-APP-AFC, the application form, which had not been filed by the assessment date. Vulcan filed the application on September 14, 2026; the filing receipt accompanies the dated assessment results. A-LIGN determined all 46 KSIs implemented, with at least two automated validation methods per KSI. Daily validation history continues to accumulate under SDR-CSX-KMT. The assessment report and control-testing export are available in the Trust Center.

vulcanExtensions.certificationStatus: FedRAMP 20x Class C (Moderate) certification is under review. A-LIGN completed the independent assessment on September 11, 2026; Vulcan filed the application on September 14. VulcanGov has held the legacy FedRAMP Ready designation since June 10, 2026. FedRAMP 20x certification and an agency Authorization to Operate are pending.
